meta.title: Fish Processing & Packing for Export
meta.description: How AZAFCO turns buyer specifications into graded, packed fish ready for dispatch: receiving, grading, processing, packing, temperature control.

hero.title: Where specifications become product ready to ship
hero.intro: The factory is where your specification is met. Here is the path a product takes, and the steps we can document, from receiving and grading to packing and preparation for dispatch.

intro.title: Built around the buyer's specification
intro.text: Our operating team matches each customer order to the work instructions and quality limits for that product type, and reviews the results before the shipment leaves.

workflow.title: From receiving to dispatch
workflow.intro: Six stages, each tied to the specification agreed for your order.
workflow.receiving_text: Fish are received and inspected under the plant's procedures.
workflow.grading_text: Product is sorted and graded by size against the order.
workflow.processing_text: Prepared according to the production order for the agreed product form.
workflow.packing_text: Weighed and packed to the agreed pack type, net weight and labels.
workflow.temperature_text: Storage and transport temperatures are set per product and its safety requirements.
workflow.dispatch_text: Shipment details are documented and the order is prepared for handover.

capabilities.title: Packing built around your market
capabilities.intro: These details are settled commercially for each order, subject to feasibility and the regulations of the destination country.
capabilities.pack_text: The box or crate type and pack size for your channel.
capabilities.weight_text: Net weight per pack, agreed in the specification.
capabilities.label_text: Label content and language, including commercial and scientific names where the market requires them.
capabilities.destination_text: Requirements of the destination country, where they apply.
capabilities.constraints: No packing option is treated as final until it is confirmed in writing.

checkpoints.title: Where checks happen
checkpoints.intro: Checks sit at the points where the specification can change: when product arrives, when it is graded and packed, and before it leaves.
checkpoints.receiving: At receiving: inspection under the plant's procedures
checkpoints.grading: At grading and packing: size, weight and pack checked against the order
checkpoints.release: Before dispatch: results reviewed before the shipment leaves
checkpoints.docs_text: Qualified buyers can request verified facility information and the operating documents relevant to their order.

coldchain.title: Temperatures set per product, not one number for everything
coldchain.text_1: Storage and transport temperatures depend on the product type, its safety requirements and the way it is supplied.
coldchain.text_2: We publish approved values per product only after review with the quality team. Until then, the temperature requirements for your order are confirmed in the quotation.

gallery.title: The plant and the people
gallery.intro: Photographs from our processing hall and loading bays.
gallery.label: Processing and dispatch photos
gallery.visit_text: Qualified buyers can ask for updated photographs, a technical meeting or a site visit, in line with company procedures.

cta.title: Tell us how you need it packed
cta.intro: Share the species, product form, pack type, net weight, labels and destination. The export team will review feasibility and come back to you.
cta.label: Request Facility Information

pending.facility: Factory location(s), opening dates (Baltim 2018 / Motobas 2025 vs About page), approval/registration numbers, capacity definition
pending.steps: Step order and control points to be confirmed by the plant manager
pending.pack_formats: Validated pack formats (box/crate types, net weights), label options, operational constraints
pending.temperature: Verified storage/transport temperature per product + control points and logs
